title: ICT基礎(再履修クラス)
subtitle: ICT Basics
courseType:
Practical Engineering Education Program
Practical Engineering Education Courses
educationalGoal: Understand the mechanics of personal computers and their capabilities and possibilities. On top of that, students will acquire the basic ability to utilize personal computers as students and members of society for purposes such as education, research, and technological development. In particular, students will acquire the ability to create documents and presentation materials and data handling skill.
advice: In this course, you will learn the following basics of using your personal computer (laptop computer) for study and student life. 1. Basic PC skills: Learn basic operations such as using Windows and software installation. 2. Networks: Learn how to set up connections to on-campus and off-campus networks, how to view on-campus and off-campus web pages, how to use the on-campus web systems, learn about network security and anti-virus software, and learn the proper behaviors when using networks. 3. MS Office software: Learn basic skills in document creation and presentation material creation. 4. Data handling skills: Learn data handling skills using spreadsheet software.
books: Introduction to ICT/Introduction to Data Science 2022
requiredKnowledge: No prior knowledge or skills are assumed. The exercises will be done on your own laptop computer. Be sure to bring your laptop computer, power adapter, and network cable (LAN cable) to each class.

activityGoals.body: To be able to understand the basics of personal computers and the usage of laptop computers.
To be able to understand the basics of Windows and to use Windows and applications that run on Windows.
To be able to understand how to install the software and make your PC available for use at our university.
To be able to understand the mechanism of virus infection and protect your computer from computer viruses.
To be able to set your network settings and use the campus network.
To be able to operate MS Office software and make effective use of data.
